meta.description: Tell us how much you have and until when. We plan your suppers around this week's specials at the shops near you.

home.headline: Suppers that fit your budget
home.intro: Tell us how much you have and until when. We plan your suppers around this week's specials at the shops near you, and show you exactly what you'll save.

location.noResults: No places found. Try a nearby suburb or town.
location.outsideSa: That location looks outside South Africa. Try searching instead.
location.locationFailed: We couldn't get your location. Search instead.
location.shopsHelp: Tap your main shop. Tap a second one for top-ups (optional).
location.reportTitle: Tell us about a missing shop
location.reportThanks: Thanks! We'll check and add it.

onboarding.title: Who and how much?
onboarding.budgetHelp: Whole rands, for all the suppers below.
onboarding.payday: Until the {day, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}}
onboarding.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
onboarding.noRecipes: No recipes are available yet. Please check back soon.

plan.suppersPerPlate: {count, plural, one {# supper} other {# suppers}} · {perPlate} a plate
plan.specialsUsed: {count, plural, =0 {no specials used} one {# special used} other {# specials used}}
plan.coversDays: {budget} covers {days, plural, one {# supper} other {# suppers}}. Want {days} instead of {total}?
plan.useDays: Plan {days, plural, one {# supper} other {# suppers}}
plan.nothingFits: Your budget doesn't cover even one supper with these shops. Try another shop or a bigger amount.
plan.mayHaveChanged: {count, plural, one {# price may have changed} other {# prices may have changed}}
plan.unpricedLink: {count, plural, one {# item we can't price yet} other {# items we can't price yet}}
plan.unpricedNote: Not included in the total. We never guess prices.
plan.seeList: See shopping list · {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}
plan.tooFewDays: {budget} covers only {days, plural, one {# supper} other {# suppers}}. Plans need at least 3: try a bigger amount or another shop.
plan.shoppedPrompt: Did you do this shop? Mark it as done to add what you saved.

actions.noOptions: No other suppers fit this day.
actions.cheaperNone: This is already the cheapest supper for this day.
actions.failed: That didn't work. Please try again.

list.title: Shopping list
list.haveDone: Moved to your pantry. List updated: you save {amount}.
list.staplesHelp: Not in your total. Add them only if you've run out.
list.unpricedHelp: We can't price these at your shops yet, so they're not in the total.
list.offline: You're offline. Ticks are saved on this phone and will sync later.
list.shoppedPrompt: All done? Mark this shop as done to add what you saved to your total.
list.shoppedDone: Shop marked as done. Leftovers are in your pantry.
list.empty: Nothing to buy: your pantry covers this plan.

savings.title: Your savings
savings.nothingYet: Mark a shop as done to start your savings total.
savings.packSharing: Pack sharing also saved you {amount} (not counted above)
savings.counts: {plans, plural, one {# shop} other {# shops}} · {receipts, plural, =0 {no slips yet} one {# slip} other {# slips}}
savings.howCounted: We count savings against the normal shelf price of the same packs, with no specials or cards.

notify.monthEndBody: Your suppers are planned until payday. Check the list before you shop.
notify.paydayBody: Plan the next stretch in one tap.
notify.specialsBody: See what they do to this week's suppers at {store}.

push.cardBody: We'll tell you what's for supper tonight.
push.explain1: Tonight's supper at 4pm on days you have a plan.
push.explain2: Payday, new specials and a nudge before month-end.
push.explain3: Never more than one a day (plus tonight's supper), and never between 8pm and 7am.
push.explain4: Switch any of them off in Settings.
push.denied: Reminders are blocked in your browser settings.
push.installBody: Open your plan and list with one tap, even offline.

receipts.title: Scan a receipt
receipts.intro: Take a clear photo of your till slip. We'll check what you paid against the normal price.
receipts.consent: I agree that {brand} reads my slip to confirm my savings and to improve prices for my shops. Card numbers and names are removed, and the photo is deleted after 30 days.
receipts.confirmed: Confirmed: you paid {paid}. Normal price {normal}. Saved {saved}.
receipts.unmatchedNote: Lines we couldn't match are shown but don't count towards your savings.
receipts.needsReview: The total on your slip didn't add up, so we couldn't confirm it. Try a clearer photo of the whole slip.
receipts.failed: We couldn't read that slip. Try again with a flat, well-lit photo.
receipts.tooLarge: That photo is too big even after shrinking it. Try again.
receipts.cap: You can scan 5 slips a day. Try again tomorrow.

tweak.label: Change something?
tweak.placeholder: e.g. No fish this week, quicker meals
tweak.notUnderstood: Sorry, we didn't understand that. Try 'no fish' or 'quicker meals'.
tweak.cap: You can make 10 changes a day.
tweak.failed: We couldn't change the plan right now.
